Preserve the exact product identity from the reference image: shape, silhouette, proportions, color, material, surface finish, label/logo placement, and visible construction details. Do not redesign the product. Do not add, remove, or relocate any product feature. Keep the label text exactly legible and unchanged; do not redraw or restyle any logo. {product}. {style_lock}. The whole layout is viewed straight-on while every inset keeps its own camera: one card photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle showing the bowl filled with the kibble, one at a high 45-degree angle showing a plain scoop tipping pieces into the bowl, one at eye level showing the pack standing at a slight 3/4 angle beside the bowl, and one from a low angle near the floor showing a cat of no identifiable breed walking past with its body cropped and its face out of frame. Natural window light inside the frames at 5200K with a warm film tone, candid slightly off-centre framing and real contact shadows under bowl, scoop and pack. Background flat oatmeal-cream #F6EBDC with 24px rounded card corners and hairline outlines in #A79683, a pale linen mat and a warm limestone floor #E3D9CC inside the frames. Four short card labels reading 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_2}」, 「{callout_3}」 and 「{callout_4}」 in #4A3A25 at 15pt under each card, headline reading 「{selling_point_1}」 in #4A3A25 at 32pt above the grid and one sub-line reading 「{selling_point_2}」 in #4A3A25 at 16pt beneath it. The cards occupy 55-60% overall. Negative: no identical duplicate frames, no repeated identical caption lines, no timeline or week-count claims, no fabricated transformation results, no breed-identifiable animal face, no duplicated animal across frames, no people, no hands, no invented portions or weights, no product hidden behind props, no over-retouched fur, no dense body text, no watermark, NOT professional studio photography, NOT an AI-generated look.

shots.intent: 唯一一块深棕收口屏把包装与一碗颗粒并置，用一个低摩擦按钮替代源图会员二维码贴片
shots.camera: the pack standing upright at a slight 3/4 angle at the left, photographed from a very low angle looking slightly upward for presence, the dish beside it seen from a high 45-degree angle
shots.lighting: soft key at 5500K from the upper left with a warm 5200K rim along the pack edge, gentle falloff into the frame edges, firm contact shadows so pack and dish clearly rest
shots.background: flat deep-roast brown #4A3A25 block screen with one warm limestone ledge #E3D9CC under the pack
shots.props: one shallow white ceramic dish with the kibble, nothing else
shots.textZone: 右上两行主标题位、其下一行短说明位、右下圆角胶囊按钮位
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce promo close for {product}: the pack and one filled dish on one dark block screen with a copy column at the right. Preserve the exact product identity from the reference image: shape, silhouette, proportions, color, material, surface finish, label/logo placement, and visible construction details. Do not redesign the product. Do not add, remove, or relocate any product feature. Keep the label text exactly legible and unchanged; do not redraw or restyle any logo. {product}. {style_lock}. The pack stands upright at a slight 3/4 angle at the left photographed from a very low angle looking slightly upward for presence, and one shallow white ceramic dish #FFFFFF holding the kibble beside it is seen from a high 45-degree angle so the pieces read individually. Soft key at 5500K from the upper left with a warm 5200K rim along the pack edge, gentle falloff into the frame edges, firm contact shadows so pack and dish clearly rest. Background flat deep-roast brown #4A3A25 block screen with one warm limestone ledge #E3D9CC under the pack. Two display headline lines reading 「{selling_point_1}」 and 「{selling_point_2}」 in #FFFFFF at 36pt at the upper right, one short line reading 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF at 16pt beneath them, and one rounded capsule button reading 「{callout_2}」 in #FFFFFF on #E06A45 at 18pt at the lower right. The pack and dish occupy 55-60% overall. Negative: no QR code, no membership, sign-up or free-store copy, no invented discounts, prices, countdown timers or coupons, no platform, brand or company names, no contact details, no certification or veterinary wording, no animal, no people, no hands, no floating product, no extra text beyond the three copy slots, no watermark, no fake logo.

provenance.notes: 源图 10 屏详情页长图切片（panel-01 至 panel-10），同一主体：一款猫用深海鱼配方天然干粮，直立软包装加浅碗与红碗盛装的哑光三角膨化颗粒，另有深海鱼原料平铺与猫低头进食实景。L1 取「宠物用品」，与源文件夹名一致。L2 取「主粮」：产品是按袋售卖、可全阶段喂给的膨化干粮，不是零食膏剂、清洁护理品或喂养器具。与库内既有 16 版显式区分：既有的主粮版「犬猫通用冲调奶粉」走奶蓝冷调 #BFE0F0 与深蓝块面，「猫用化毛膏」走天空蓝加亮黄卡通波浪，「犬猫益生菌片」走粉青 3D 展台，「犬猫口服液」走矢车菊蓝临床光带，本模版走暖燕麦奶白 #F6EBDC、海雾绿单块 #BCD6C9、深焙棕墨文字与收口块 #4A3A25、三文鱼强调 #E06A45，版式母件为四分圆盘编号、贴碗沿极低角度引线胶囊与「细线加短实心划」分隔规，均与上述版本不重叠；寝具版「犬用双面加绒睡垫」虽同用暖橙下划线，本套已改为无下划线的分隔规并去掉灰紫渐变与木纹。已剥离：源图全部中文口号与英文小字（含 DEEP SEA FISH 拼写错误行）一律改为 {selling_point_N} 与 {callout_N}；panel-03 四块灰色空图占位方格按语义补为可拍摄的四格困扰画面并明令禁止灰块残留；panel-09 与 panel-10 把同一句「猫咪食欲增加 不在挑食」与同一行 CATS HAVE INCREASED APPETITE 重复五次且英文被截断，属复用模板遗留文字，整段删除，改为四格实拍加占位标签；panel-10 左下黑色「加入会员 全店免费」贴片及其二维码全部删除并在负面清单逐镜禁用；panel-06 的「减少肾脏的负荷」「肾衰竭」等内脏与疾病表述、panel-07 与 panel-08 的原料名清单、panel-08 的「3KG」「十八个月」「所有」适用与储存提示、以及虾青素与 OMEGA3 等成分字样全部不写死，改由产品参考图与占位承担，并在负面清单禁用成分表、净重、体积、年龄段、保质期、认证、检验报告与兽医背书。两只出镜猫（异国短毛与折耳特征明显）一律降为 no identifiable breed 并要求裁切或低头背对，不得出现可识别个体面部，另禁人脸人手；颗粒在微距与平铺镜中锁定同一挤出外形与烘焙棕 #B07C3E，禁止油亮反光与平铺重复贴图。机位分布：正平视 0 度、高 30 度俯视、正平视四格、正平视图标带、正上方 90 度双栏、碗沿极低角度仰视、贴地低角度抓拍、正上方 90 度平铺、正平视双栏、四格混合机位、极低角度仰视收口共 10 类，无三连同角，含 4 次俯视与 2 次仰视；全景 4/11 约 36%，特写与微距 4 镜，符合节奏要求。
